title: Dynamic acorns
description: Add acorns to grow on oak trees. Make them into brown dye and use them to smelt items!
body: Dynamic Acorns adds pickable acorns to natural oak leaves. Acorns appear on exposed leaf faces, can be collected by right-clicking, and drop if the player inventory is full or the leaf is broken. They work alongside Dynamic Apples by avoiding apple leaves, and they can also be used as furnace fuel, placed in composters for bonemeal progress, or crafted into brown dye.
